# Home wifi keeps dropping

Check the router channel: 2.4 GHz channels 1, 6 and 11 do not overlap, so pick the least busy one. Move the router off the
floor and away from the microwave. If only one laptop drops, update its wireless driver. Reboot the router weekly, and
set the DNS servers to 1.1.1.1 if pages stall on "resolving host".
